# I Held the Line

> Unofficial fan site tracking Squadron 42 — Cloud Imperium Games' single-player campaign set in the Star Citizen universe. "I held the line" is what long-time backers say while waiting for the game to ship. The site covers development news from official CIG sources, the confirmed cast, official trailers and videos, a complete FAQ, and a Q2 2027 release-window tracker. For Star Citizen backers and anyone following Squadron 42's release. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloud Imperium Games or Roberts Space Industries.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://iheldtheline.com/): What "I held the line" means, the Q2 2027 release window tracker, and an index of the site.
- [Development News](https://iheldtheline.com/news): Squadron 42 updates from official CIG sources — monthly reports, CitizenCon reveals, and milestone announcements, newest first.
- [Cast](https://iheldtheline.com/cast): The confirmed Squadron 42 cast — Mark Hamill, Gary Oldman, Gillian Anderson, Henry Cavill, Andy Serkis, Liam Cunningham, Mark Strong, Sophie Wu, Ben Mendelsohn, and John Rhys-Davies — with roles and official sources.
- [Release Date Tracker](https://iheldtheline.com/release-date): Every official CIG statement on the Squadron 42 release window in one place; delayed from 2026 to Q2 2027 in August 2026.
- [Playtest Event](https://iheldtheline.com/playtest-event): The invite-only Squadron 42 hands-on event at CIG's Manchester studio, October 2026 — who is invited, what happens, and what is known. CIG confirmed the sessions publicly in the August 2026 Letter from the Chairman and said a specific release date follows shortly afterwards.
- [FAQ](https://iheldtheline.com/faq): Answers to common questions about Squadron 42 — what it is, when it ships, and how it relates to Star Citizen.
- [Bishop's Speeches](https://iheldtheline.com/bishops-speech): Admiral Bishop's Squadron 42 speeches — the 2015 Senate address and the in-game prologue — with context and official sources.
- [SQ42 vs Star Citizen](https://iheldtheline.com/sq42-vs-star-citizen): The key differences between the single-player campaign and the multiplayer game, from official CIG sources.
- [Worth Buying](https://iheldtheline.com/worth-buying): Whether to pledge for Squadron 42 now, explained plainly.
- [Gameplay](https://iheldtheline.com/gameplay): What Squadron 42 gameplay looks like based on official reveals.
- [Official Videos](https://iheldtheline.com/videos): Every official Squadron 42 video from CIG — trailers, gameplay reveals, and CitizenCon presentations.
- [The Vanduul](https://iheldtheline.com/vanduul): The nomadic alien faction Squadron 42's campaign is fought against.
- [Odin System](https://iheldtheline.com/odin-system): The system that serves as Squadron 42's theater of operations.
- [I Held the Line Trailer](https://iheldtheline.com/i-held-the-line-trailer): The trailer and moment behind the "I held the line" phrase.
- [About](https://iheldtheline.com/about): Source policy and site information.

## Key facts

- Squadron 42 is Cloud Imperium Games' single-player campaign set in the Star Citizen universe.
- Squadron 42 targets a Q2 2027 release window (April to June 2027). Chris Roberts set this in the Letter from the Chairman of August 27, 2026, moving the game out of its previous 2026 target.
- Squadron 42 was delayed from 2026 to Q2 2027 to avoid launching alongside Grand Theft Auto 6. CIG's original plan had been to ship in Q4 2026 around IAE. The delay was a launch-calendar decision, not a development one — the game is content complete.
- CIG has not announced an exact release day. Chris Roberts said a specific release date will be announced shortly after backer and content-creator play sessions on October 9 and 10, 2026.
- Squadron 42 is a standalone game separate from Star Citizen, the multiplayer game in the same universe.
- The confirmed cast includes Mark Hamill, Gary Oldman, Gillian Anderson, Henry Cavill, Andy Serkis, Liam Cunningham, Mark Strong, Sophie Wu, Ben Mendelsohn, and John Rhys-Davies.
- The first hands-on Squadron 42 experience for players outside CIG is an invite-only event at the Manchester studio in October 2026, communicated through private invitation emails to longtime backers ("those who Held the Line"). The invitation describes a three-day weekend of October 9–11; the August 27, 2026 Letter from the Chairman, the first public CIG confirmation of the sessions, names October 9 and 10 as the days people play.
- Every factual claim on this site is drawn from official CIG sources (monthly reports, newsletters, CitizenCon showcases).
